findings.message: `proj.web.trends` is partitioned by `refresh_date`, but comparing `refresh_date` with a subquery can't limit which partitions are read, so the query reads every partition (3.2 GB in all).
findings.fix: Add a filter on `refresh_date`, for example `refresh_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
